name: Khinganornis
sum: Euornithean from the Aptian Longjiang Formation of Inner Mongolia known from a nearly complete skeleton.
holotype: SGM-AVE-2017001, a nearly complete skeleton with skull on slab and counterslab, Hebei GEO University.
material: The holotype and a referred specimen in PBDB.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Wang et al. 2020

sources.text:
